project_type: Rule Engine API — Go backend (engine) + Strapi 5 CMS (TypeScript)
build_system: Go modules for engine; npm + TypeScript for CMS
test_framework: go test for engine; vitest for CMS
test_command: cd engine && go test ./... (engine); cd cms && npx vitest run (CMS)
verification_instructions: Engine: `cd /home/nuzirwan/project/rule-engine-api/.worktrees/multi-secret-refs/engine && go build ./... && go test ./...`. CMS: `cd /home/nuzirwan/project/rule-engine-api/.worktrees/multi-secret-refs/cms && npx tsc --noEmit && npm run test -- --run`
environment_constraints: Worktree at /home/nuzirwan/project/rule-engine-api/.worktrees/multi-secret-refs. Use absolute paths when editing files.
contribution_requirements: Backward compatibility is critical — existing single SecretRef must continue to work. No DB migration. additive changes only.

key_patterns.context_helpers: WithSecret/SecretFrom pattern in connector.go — use secretCtxKey struct for context value keys
key_patterns.optional_interface: SecretSchemaProvider is optional interface via type assertion, not modifying base Connector interface
key_patterns.connector_structure: Each connector in drivers/ implements Connector interface (Type, Open, Lifecycle, Capabilities)
key_patterns.registry_resolution: registry.open() and pool.open() resolve secrets before calling connector.Open()
key_patterns.admin_handlers: Admin handlers in httpapi/admin_handlers.go, routes in admin.go mount()
key_patterns.cms_lifecycles: Content-type validation in lifecycles.ts using beforeCreate/beforeUpdate hooks
key_patterns.engine_types: Wire types in cms/types/engine.ts, sync via admin-client.ts

directory_structure.engine/internal/connect/drivers/: Concrete connector implementations (postgres, mysql, valkey, rest, kafka, rabbitmq)
directory_structure.cms/src/plugins/rule-engine/admin/src/: CMS admin UI components and pages
directory_structure.cms/types/: Shared TypeScript types for engine API
